title.zh-TW: 面板新增「絨毛小夥伴」主題

body.zh-TW:
查看用量想少點枯燥，現在有動物陪你看額度。到 **⚙ 設定 → 切換面板** 選「絨毛小夥伴」，共 18 種主題，固定亮色不受系統深淺影響。米白卡片配咖啡縫邊，底下 11 個原創絨毛角色散步，點選看名字，偶爾聊天打盹。

每條額度進度條站一位角色，停在目前百分比。5 小時與週額度較近上限那條用到 80% 會緊張，用完睡著，重置時醒來歡呼。

小夥伴只在要緊時出泡泡，一次一個：額度到 80%、用完與重置，或睡著後重置前約 10 分鐘伸懶腰。現速將提前用完會報剩餘時間，並推薦有空位的工具。Claude 或 Codex 回報故障及恢復時也會出現泡泡。今日用量超昨天整排歡呼，過半夜也有泡泡。每天首次造訪時，依週額度剛重置、隔幾天回來、週一或週五，或當下時段換招呼。12 月飄雪，隊尾日換一棵毛氈聖誕樹。

⟦過去只盯數字，現在公仔見底打盹、補滿歡呼。⟧
body.en:
To make checking usage less dry, animals now keep you company while you watch your quotas. Go to **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel** and pick "Plush Pals", one of 18 themes, fixed in its light look regardless of system appearance. Cream cards with brown stitched edges sit above 11 original plush characters strolling along; click one to see its name, and now and then they chat or doze off.

One character stands on each quota bar at its current percentage. Between the 5-hour and weekly quotas, the one closer to its limit looks worried at 80%, falls asleep when it runs out, and wakes up cheering when it resets.

The pals only show speech bubbles when it matters, one at a time: when a quota hits 80%, runs out, or resets, or when a sleeping pal stretches about 10 minutes before reset. If the current pace will empty a quota early, it reports the time left and recommends a tool that still has room. Bubbles also appear when Claude or Codex reports an outage or recovers. When today's usage passes yesterday's, the whole row cheers, and there is a bubble after midnight too. On each day's first visit, the greeting adapts to a freshly reset weekly quota, returning after a few days, Monday or Friday, or the time of day. In December, snow falls, and a different felt Christmas tree stands at the end of the line each day.

⟦Picture staring only at numbers before, whereas now plushies doze off at empty and cheer when refilled.⟧

items.original: **New panel theme: Plush Pals.** Cream cards with a brown stitched rim, and eleven original plush animals that stroll along a row under the cards. One pal sits on each quota bar at its current percentage; it looks worried from 80% and falls asleep when the quota runs out (whichever of the 5-hour and weekly quotas is closer to the limit), and wakes up cheering when it resets. The pals speak up only when it matters, one speech bubble at a time: when a quota reaches 80%, runs out or resets; when a sleeping pal's quota is about 10 minutes from resetting (it stretches); when the current pace would empty a quota early (saying how long is left, and which other tool still has room); when Claude or Codex reports an outage and when it recovers; when today's usage passes yesterday's (the line cheers); on the day's first visit, with a greeting that fits (a weekly quota that just reset, a return after a few days, Monday or Friday, or the time of day); and after midnight. Now and then two pals in line chat or one dozes off. In December snow falls across the panel and a felt Christmas tree, a different one each day, stands at its end. Click a pal to see its name. Pick it from **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel**; there are now 18 themes. The panel always uses its light look, whatever the system appearance.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式選詞更準並可單獨標懂名詞
title.en: Beginner Mode Picks Better Terms and Marks Them One by One

body.zh-TW:
用新手模式學名詞，以前只懂一兩個詞卻得按 9 全標，還常被無關的檔名或路徑佔掉三個提示位置。現在按 4～6 就能單獨標懂對應的那一個名詞，按 9 照舊三個一起標。分支名稱、檔名、路徑、單獨數字與 PR（請求把修改併回主線）編號不再佔位，每個提示也都會真的出現在 Claude 的回答裡。

同一概念的兩種寫法現在也算同一個詞。標過「分支」或「branch」懂了，兩者就不再當新詞提示；標過「PR」或「Pull Request」懂了，「PR」和「pull request」也不會再跳出。上述詞彙只要自己打出任一種寫法，就算你會了。

⟦以前背詞像整串鑰匙一起收、還常夾進門牌號，現在能拆開單獨收好，同一把的中英文兩把也只要認得一支就算過關。⟧
body.en:
When learning terms in Beginner Mode, you previously had to press 9 to mark all three even if you only knew one or two, and unrelated file names or paths often took up the three hint slots. Now pressing 4–6 marks just the corresponding term understood, while 9 still marks all three. Branch names, file names, paths, bare numbers, and PR (pull request) numbers no longer take up slots, and every hint actually appears in Claude's reply.

Two names for the same concept now count as one term. Once you mark "分支" or "branch" understood, neither appears as a new hint; once you mark "PR" or "Pull Request" understood, "PR" and "pull request" stop popping up too. Typing either form of those terms yourself counts as knowing it.

⟦Think of studying terms before like putting away a whole keyring with house numbers mixed in; now you can unclip and store each key on its own, and recognizing either the Chinese or English copy of the same key counts.⟧

items.original:
**Beginner Mode lets you mark terms one at a time and skips project names.** Press 4–6 to mark a single term understood; 9 still marks all three. Branch names, PR numbers, file names, paths and bare numbers no longer take the three hint slots, and every hint must appear in Claude's answer.
**Beginner Mode treats two names for one idea as one term.** Once you mark "分支（branch）" or "PR（Pull Request）" understood, "branch", "分支", "PR" and "pull request" stop appearing as new hints, and typing either name counts as knowing it.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式紀錄保存與提示比對更可靠
title.en: Beginner Mode Saves Progress and Matches Hints More Reliably

body.zh-TW:
多視窗存檔打架與解答斷句這類新手模式的小狀況，現在都有解了。

兩個對話同時存檔時，每次改動都在存檔前一刻重讀名詞紀錄，較不會弄丟「懂了」。紀錄讀不到時不再先請 Haiku 挑詞，5 小時額度的暫停改看該額度自己的讀取與重置時間。

白話解釋改請 Haiku 寫出完整短句，長度上限加倍到 80 個字元，不再被切成半句。之前存成半句的解釋，下次那個詞再出現時會換成完整版。

用一種寫法學會的詞，不論先遇到哪種寫法，換另一種都不會再回來。回答只有 `RAPID` 字樣時不再算出現 `API`，`PR #42`、Windows 路徑與 `fix/test` 分支名也不再佔位。Haiku 在清單前多寫一句話時，缺欄位的單一詞彙不再連累其他詞消失，每則回答讀名詞紀錄的次數也變少。

現在多視窗並行時，標記較不易漏存、解釋看得到整句，提示也只留回答真正用到的詞。
body.en:
Small Beginner Mode hiccups like competing window saves and cut-off explanations are now fixed.

When two conversations save at once, each change re-reads the term list right before saving so "understood" marks are less likely to be lost. When the list is unreadable, it no longer asks Haiku for terms first, and the 5-hour quota pause now follows that quota's own reading and reset times.

Plain-language explanations now ask Haiku for a complete short sentence, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters so they are no longer cut in half. Any explanation saved half-finished is replaced with the full version the next time that term appears.

A term learned under one spelling never comes back under the other, whichever you saw first. Replies containing only `RAPID` no longer count as showing `API`, and `PR #42`, Windows paths, and `fix/test` branch names no longer take up slots. When Haiku adds a line of preamble before the list, a single term with a missing field no longer causes the other terms to disappear, and each reply reads the term list fewer times.

Now when multiple windows run in parallel, marks are less likely to drop, explanations show full sentences, and hints keep only the terms the reply actually uses.

items.original:
**Beginner Mode loses fewer "understood" marks when two conversations save at once.** Each change now re-reads the term list right before saving. It also stops asking Haiku for terms while the term list is unreadable, and the 5-hour pause now follows that quota's own reading time and reset.
**Beginner Mode explanations are no longer cut off mid-sentence.** Haiku is asked for a complete short phrase, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters. An explanation saved half-finished is replaced the next time its term comes up.
**Beginner Mode hints only what the answer really uses.** A term learned under one name no longer comes back under its other name, whichever came first. `API` no longer counts as appearing just because the answer says `RAPID`. PR numbers like `PR #42`, Windows paths and branch names such as `fix/test` no longer take hint slots, and one malformed term after a line of preamble no longer drops the others. Each reply also reads the term list fewer times.
